$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: QR code
blocks.for: A QR code as shapes in millimetres: what it says (a link, text, Wi-Fi, a contact card) into merged module outlines, square, rounded, dots or round finders, with an optional cleared centre for a symbol, and the smallest code that keeps a module floor.
